---
title: "Isochrones"
format: html
editor: visual
---

An **isochrone** is a line or polygon on a map that connects all points reachable from a specific starting location within a set amount of time

[Inspiration from Kyle Walker](https://walker-data.com/posts/accessibility-surface/)

### Libraries

```{r}
library(mapboxapi)
library(leaflet)
library(mapview)
```

### Create Isochrone

```{r}
isos <- mb_isochrone(
  location = "One Bowerman Dr, Beaverton, OR 97005",
  profile = "driving",
  time = 1:45
)
```

```{r}
mapview(isos, zcol = "time")
```

```{r}
library(sf)
library(fasterize)

isos_proj <- st_transform(isos, 32618)

template <- raster(isos_proj, resolution = 100)

iso_surface <- fasterize(isos_proj, template, field = "time", fun = "min")

iso_surface
pal <- colorNumeric("plasma", isos$time, na.color = "transparent")

nike_map <- leaflet() %>%
  addMapboxTiles(style_id = "light-v9",
                 username = "mapbox",
                 scaling_factor = "0.5x") %>%
  addRasterImage(iso_surface, colors = pal, opacity = 0.5) %>%
  addLegend(values = isos$time, pal = pal,
            title = "Drive-time from<br>Nike HQ")

nike_map
```

```{r}
nike_icon <- makeIcon(
  iconUrl = "https://nike.com/favicon.ico",
  iconWidth = 25,
  iconHeight = 25
)

nike_hq <- mb_geocode("One Bowerman Dr, Beaverton, OR 97005")

nike_map %>%
  addMarkers(lng = nike_hq[1], lat = nike_hq[2], icon = nike_icon)
```

# Introduction

Ocean rescue accessibility is an important part of emergency preparedness on Oʻahu, Hawaiʻi.

This project examines three types of coastal emergency accessibility:

1.  Swimming and shoreline rescue access
2.  Lifeguard response
3.  Coast Guard marine response

# Research Question

**How does estimated accessibility to swimming rescue, lifeguard response, and Coast Guard services vary across Oʻahu?**

# Data Sources

-   [Honolulu Lifeguard Towers](https://data.honolulu.gov/d/8crx-qhct)
-   [Hawaiʻi GIS Body Surfing Sites](https://geodata.hawaii.gov/arcgis/rest/services/CoastalMarine/MapServer/9)
-   [Hawaiʻi GIS Shoreline Access](https://geodata.hawaii.gov/arcgis/rest/services/CoastalMarine/MapServer/25)
-   [Hawaiʻi GIS Data Catalog](https://planning.hawaii.gov/gis/download-gis-data-expanded/)
-   [USCG Sector Honolulu](https://www.pacificarea.uscg.mil/Our-Organization/Oceania-District/Oceania-District-Units/Sector-Honolulu/Sector-Honolulu-Units/)
-   [NOAA Electronic Navigational Charts](https://charts.noaa.gov/ENCs/ENCs.shtml)

```{r}
#| label: load-gis-data

data_dir <- "data"

required_files <- c(
  "lifeguards.geojson",
  "body_surfing.geojson",
  "shoreline_access.geojson",
  "oahu_roads.geojson"
)

missing_files <- required_files[
  !file.exists(file.path(data_dir, required_files))
]

if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing files: ",
    paste(missing_files, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

lifeguards <- st_read(
  file.path(data_dir, "lifeguards.geojson"),
  quiet = TRUE
) |> st_transform(4326)

body_surfing <- st_read(
  file.path(data_dir, "body_surfing.geojson"),
  quiet = TRUE
) |> st_transform(4326)

shoreline <- st_read(
  file.path(data_dir, "shoreline_access.geojson"),
  quiet = TRUE
) |> st_transform(4326)

roads <- st_read(
  file.path(data_dir, "oahu_roads.geojson"),
  quiet = TRUE
) |> st_transform(4326)

# Coast Guard facility table is optional.
coast_guard_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "coast_guard_facilities.csv"
)

if (file.exists(coast_guard_file)) {
  coast_guard <- read.csv(coast_guard_file)
} else {
  coast_guard <- data.frame(
    name = character(),
    address = character()
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: filter-oahu

oahu_bbox <- st_bbox(
  c(
    xmin = -158.30,
    ymin = 21.20,

oahu_extent <- st_as_sfc(oahu_bbox)

lifeguards <- st_filter(

)

body_surfing <- st_filter(
  body_surfing, oahu_extent
)

shoreline <- st_filter(

roads <- st_filter(

)
```

# Lifeguard Response Accessibility

```{r}
#| label: lifeguard-calculations

lifeguards_utm <- st_transform(
  lifeguards, 32604
)

surf_utm <- st_transform(
  body_surfing, 32604
)

stopifnot(
  nrow(lifeguards_utm) > 0,
  nrow(surf_utm) > 0
)

nearest_lifeguard <- st_nearest_feature(
  surf_utm,
  lifeguards_utm
)

lifeguard_distance <- st_distance(
  surf_utm,
  lifeguards_utm[nearest_lifeguard, ],
  by_element = TRUE
)

surf_utm$lifeguard_distance_km <-
  as.numeric(lifeguard_distance) / 1000

# Illustrative speed, not observed response speed.
lifeguard_speed_kmh <- 5

surf_utm$lifeguard_time_min <-
  surf_utm$lifeguard_distance_km /
  lifeguard_speed_kmh * 60

surf_utm$lifeguard_category <- cut(
  surf_utm$lifeguard_time_min,
  breaks = c(-Inf, 5, 10, 20, Inf),
  labels = c(
    "0-5 min",
    "5-10 min",
    "10-20 min",
    "20+ min"
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| label: lifeguard-table

lifeguard_results <- surf_utm |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(
    lifeguard_distance_km,
    lifeguard_time_min,
    lifeguard_category
  )

knitr::kable(
  head(lifeguard_results, 15),
  digits = 2,
  caption = "Illustrative lifeguard proximity results"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: lifeguard-map

time_colors <- c(
  "0-5 min" = "#2ECC71",
  "5-10 min" = "#F1C40F",
  "10-20 min" = "#E67E22",
  "20+ min" = "#E74C3C"
)

lifeguard_pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = time_colors,
  domain = levels(surf_utm$lifeguard_category)
)

lifeguard_map <- leaflet() |>
  addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = st_transform(surf_utm, 4326),
    radius = 7,
    color = ~lifeguard_pal(lifeguard_category),
    fillColor = ~lifeguard_pal(lifeguard_category),
    fillOpacity = 0.85,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "Nearest tower: ",
      round(lifeguard_distance_km, 2),
      " km<br>",
      "Hypothetical time: ",
      round(lifeguard_time_min, 1),
      " min"
    )
  ) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = lifeguards,
    radius = 5,
    color = "blue",
    group = "Lifeguard Towers"
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = lifeguard_pal,
    values = surf_utm$lifeguard_category,
    title = "Hypothetical Time"
  ) |>
  setView(
    lng = -157.95,
    lat = 21.48,
    zoom = 10
  )

lifeguard_map
```

# Swimming and Shoreline Rescue Accessibility

```{r}
#| label: swimming-calculations

shore_utm <- st_transform(
  shoreline, 32604
)

stopifnot(nrow(shore_utm) > 0)

nearest_shore <- st_nearest_feature(
  surf_utm,
  shore_utm
)

shore_distance <- st_distance(
  surf_utm,
  shore_utm[nearest_shore, ],
  by_element = TRUE
)

surf_utm$swim_distance_km <-
  as.numeric(shore_distance) / 1000

# Illustrative swimming speed
swim_speed_kmh <- 2

surf_utm$swim_time_min <-
  surf_utm$swim_distance_km /
  swim_speed_kmh * 60

surf_utm$swim_category <- cut(
  surf_utm$swim_time_min,
  breaks = c(-Inf, 5, 10, 20, Inf),
  labels = c(
    "0-5 min",
    "5-10 min",
    "10-20 min",
    "20+ min"
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| label: swimming-table

swim_results <- surf_utm |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(

  )

knitr::kable(
```

```{r}
#| label: coast-guard-map

has_coordinates <- all(
  c("longitude", "latitude") %in% names(coast_guard)
)

if (has_coordinates) {

  valid_rows <- !is.na(coast_guard$longitude) &
    !is.na(coast_guard$latitude)

  valid_facilities <- coast_guard[
    valid_rows,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

} else {

  valid_facilities <- coast_guard[FALSE, , drop = FALSE]

}

if (nrow(valid_facilities) > 0) {

  coast_guard_sf <- st_as_sf(
    valid_facilities,
    coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
    crs = 4326
  )

  leaflet(coast_guard_sf) |>
    addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") |>
    addCircleMarkers(
      radius = 8,
      color = "purple",
      popup = "Coast Guard facility"
    ) |>
    setView(
      lng = -157.95,
      lat = 21.48,
      zoom = 10
    )

} else {

  cat(
    "Coast Guard facility coordinates are not yet ",
    "verified. No station point is plotted."
  )

}
```

```{r}
#| label: marine-time-function

marine_time <- function(
  distance_nm,
  speed_knots,
  mobilization_min = 0
) {

  if (
    any(distance_nm < 0) ||
    any(speed_knots <= 0) ||
    any(mobilization_min < 0)
  ) {
    stop("Invalid marine travel-time inputs.")
  }

  mobilization_min +
    (distance_nm / speed_knots) * 60
}

# Mathematical example only:
# 10 nautical miles at 20 knots.
marine_time(
  distance_nm = 10,
  speed_knots = 20
)
```

# Limitations

This analysis is preliminary and exploratory.

The lifeguard and swimming accessibility models use straight-line distances and hypothetical travel speeds.

The models do not account for actual dispatch, staff availability, currents, waves, reefs, equipment, or rescue procedures.

Body-surfing sites are used as sample coastal destinations rather than observed emergency incident locations.

The study area is defined using an approximate bounding box rather than an official island boundary.

Coast Guard response times are not calculated because operational marine departure locations and navigable routes have not been verified.

# Conclusion

This project provides an initial geospatial assessment of swimming and lifeguard accessibility across Oʻahu.

It also establishes a data framework for future Coast Guard marine accessibility analysis.

The preliminary models help demonstrate how geographic distance and assumed travel speeds can be used to investigate potential coastal accessibility differences.

Further operational and marine data are required before these results can support conclusions about actual emergency response performance.

```{r}
# ============================================================
# DS422 - Oahu Ocean Rescue Accessibility Shiny App
# Swimming | Lifeguard | Coast Guard
# ============================================================

# 1. PACKAGES -----------------------------------------------

library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)
library(DT)

# 2. LOAD DATA ----------------------------------------------

results_path <- "outputs/ocean_rescue_accessibility.geojson"

if (!file.exists(results_path)) {
  stop(
    "Missing outputs/ocean_rescue_accessibility.geojson. ",
    "Render ocean_rescue.qmd first to create it."
  )
}

sites <- st_read(results_path, quiet = TRUE) |>
  st_transform(4326)

# Check that the Quarto report exported the needed fields.
required_columns <- c(
  "lifeguard_distance_km",
  "swim_distance_km"
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(
  required_columns,
  names(sites)
)

if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing columns in exported GeoJSON: ",
    paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "),
    ". Re-render the complete ocean_rescue.qmd."
  )
}

read_optional_sf <- function(path) {
  if (file.exists(path)) {
    st_read(path, quiet = TRUE) |>
      st_transform(4326)
  } else {
    NULL
  }
}

lifeguards <- read_optional_sf(
  "data/lifeguards.geojson"
)

shoreline <- read_optional_sf(
  "data/shoreline_access.geojson"
)

coast_guard_path <- "data/coast_guard_facilities.csv"

if (file.exists(coast_guard_path)) {
  coast_guard <- read.csv(
    coast_guard_path,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
} else {
  coast_guard <- data.frame(
    name = character(),
    address = character()
  )
}

# Only plot Coast Guard points with coordinates.
# Facility coordinates are not automatically
# operational boat-departure coordinates.

coast_guard_sf <- NULL

if (all(
  c("longitude", "latitude") %in% names(coast_guard)
)) {
  
  coast_guard$longitude <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(coast_guard$longitude)
  )
  
  coast_guard$latitude <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(coast_guard$latitude)
  )
  
  valid <- is.finite(coast_guard$longitude) &
    is.finite(coast_guard$latitude) &
    coast_guard$longitude >= -180 &
    coast_guard$longitude <= 180 &
    coast_guard$latitude >= -90 &
    coast_guard$latitude <= 90
  
  if (any(valid)) {
    coast_guard_sf <- st_as_sf(
      coast_guard[valid, , drop = FALSE],
      coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
      crs = 4326
    )
  }
}

# 4. SERVER -------------------------------------------------

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  # Change the default speed when a service changes.
  observeEvent(input$service, {
    
    if (input$service == "Swimming Rescue") {
      updateSliderInput(
        session,
        "speed",
        value = 2
      )
    }
    
    if (input$service == "Lifeguard Response") {
      updateSliderInput(
        session,
        "speed",
        value = 5
      )
    }
    
  })
  
  # 5. REACTIVE ACCESSIBILITY CALCULATIONS ------------------
  
  accessibility_data <- reactive({
    
    if (input$service == "Coast Guard Response") {
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    data <- sites
    
    if (input$service == "Lifeguard Response") {
      data$distance_km <-
        as.numeric(data$lifeguard_distance_km)
    } else {
      data$distance_km <-
        as.numeric(data$swim_distance_km)
    }
    
    req(input$speed > 0)
    
    data$time_min <-
      data$distance_km / input$speed * 60
    
    data$category <- cut(
      data$time_min,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 5, 10, 20, Inf),
      labels = c(
        "0-5 min",
        "5-10 min",
        "10-20 min",
        "20+ min"
      )
    )
    
    data
  })
  
  # 6. SUMMARY STATISTICS ----------------------------------
  
  output$total_sites <- renderText({
    nrow(sites)
  })
  
  output$mean_time <- renderText({
    
    data <- accessibility_data()
    
    if (is.null(data)) {
      return("Not available")
    }
    
    if (all(is.na(data$time_min))) {
      return("Not available")
    }
    
    paste0(
      round(
        mean(data$time_min, na.rm = TRUE),
        1
      ),
      " min"
    )
    
  })
  
  output$accessible_sites <- renderText({
    
    data <- accessibility_data()
    
    if (is.null(data)) {
      return("Not available")
    }
    
    sum(
      data$time_min <= as.numeric(input$threshold),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
    
  })
  
  # 7. MAP COLORS -------------------------------------------
  
  time_labels <- c(
    "0-5 min",
    "5-10 min",
    "10-20 min",
    "20+ min"
  )
  
  time_colors <- c(
    "#2ECC71",  # Green: 0-5 minutes
    "#F1C40F",  # Yellow: 5-10 minutes
    "#E67E22",  # Orange: 10-20 minutes
    "#E74C3C"   # Red: 20+ minutes
  )
  
  time_palette <- leaflet::colorFactor(
    palette = time_colors,
    domain = time_labels,
    ordered = TRUE
  )
  

  
  # 8. INTERACTIVE MAP --------------------------------------
  
  output$rescue_map <- renderLeaflet({
    
    map <- leaflet(
      options = leafletOptions(preferCanvas = TRUE)
    ) |>
      addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") |>
      setView(
        lng = -157.95,
        lat = 21.48,
        zoom = 10
      )
    
    # Coast Guard: show available facility information.
    if (input$service == "Coast Guard Response") {
      
      if (!is.null(coast_guard_sf)) {
        
        map <- map |>
          addCircleMarkers(
            data = coast_guard_sf,
            radius = 8,
            color = "purple",
            fillOpacity = 0.9,
            popup = "Coast Guard facility"
          )
        
      }
      
      return(map)
    }
    
    data <- accessibility_data()
    
    map <- map |>
      addCircleMarkers(
        data = data,
        radius = 7,
        stroke = TRUE,
        weight = 1,
        color = ~time_palette(as.character(category)),
        fillColor = ~time_palette(as.character(category)),
        fillOpacity = 0.85,
        popup = ~paste0(
          "<b>Coastal Site</b>",
          "<br>Distance: ",
          round(distance_km, 2),
          " km",
          "<br>Hypothetical time: ",
          round(time_min, 1),
          " minutes",
          "<br>Category: ",
          category
        )
      )
    
    if (
      input$service == "Lifeguard Response" &&
      !is.null(lifeguards)
    ) {
      
      map <- map |>
        addCircleMarkers(
          data = lifeguards,
          radius = 5,
          color = "blue",
          fillOpacity = 0.9,
          group = "Lifeguard Towers"
        )
      
    }
    
    if (
      input$service == "Swimming Rescue" &&
      !is.null(shoreline)
    ) {
      
      map <- map |>
        addCircleMarkers(
          data = shoreline,
          radius = 4,
          color = "purple",
          fillOpacity = 0.8,
          group = "Shoreline Access"
        )
      
    }
    
    map |>
      addLegend(
        position = "bottomright",
        colors = time_colors,
        labels = time_labels,
        title = "Hypothetical Time",
        opacity = 1
      )
    
  })
  
  # 9. RESULTS TABLE ----------------------------------------
  
  output$results_table <- renderDT({
    
    if (input$service == "Coast Guard Response") {
      
      return(
        datatable(
          coast_guard,
          options = list(pageLength = 5),
          rownames = FALSE
        )
      )
      
    }
    
    data <- accessibility_data()
    
    table_data <- data |>
      st_drop_geometry() |>
      transmute(
        `Distance (km)` = round(distance_km, 2),
        `Time (min)` = round(time_min, 1),
        `Accessibility` = as.character(category)
      )
    
    datatable(
      table_data,
      options = list(
        pageLength = 10,
        scrollX = TRUE
      ),
      rownames = FALSE
    )
    
  })
  
  # 10. METHODOLOGY -----------------------------------------
  
  output$methodology <- renderUI({
    
    if (input$service == "Swimming Rescue") {
      
      tagList(
        h4("Swimming / Shoreline Accessibility"),
        p(
          "Distances are measured from coastal ",
          "recreation sites to the nearest mapped ",
          "public shoreline access point."
        ),
        p(
          "The selected speed is hypothetical. ",
          "The model does not account for currents, ",
          "waves, land barriers, or rescue equipment."
        )
      )
      
    } else if (
      input$service == "Lifeguard Response"
    ) {
      
      tagList(
        h4("Lifeguard Accessibility"),
        p(
          "Distances are measured from coastal ",
          "recreation sites to the nearest mapped ",
          "lifeguard tower."
        ),
        p(
          "This is a straight-line proximity model, ",
          "not a measured lifeguard response-time model."
        )
      )
      
    } else {
      
      tagList(
        h4("Coast Guard Accessibility"),
        p(
          "Coast Guard facility information is shown ",
          "when available."
        ),
        p(
          "Marine response-time estimates are not ",
          "available until operational departure points ",
          "and navigable marine routes are verified."
        ),
        p(
          "Facility coordinates, if provided, ",
          "must not be assumed to represent ",
          "boat-departure locations."
        )
      )
      
    }
    
  })
  
}

# 11. LAUNCH APP --------------------------------------------

shinyApp(
  ui = ui,
  server = server
)
```
